body:
Give the Design page's canvas a zoom level and controls for panning, so the human can look at a screen bigger than the space it's drawn in, or smaller than it. The Design page has neither today. A screen drawn at a size the human picks needs both (task:1cf044ccf5423404).

## Done when

- The human can set the canvas's zoom level and pan around it.
- Selecting, region selection and notes still pick the right elements at any zoom level and pan position.
- The design README describes it.

## Open (for the human)

- What the zoom and pan controls look like, and where they go.
title: design page: zoom and pan the canvas
